title: What If You Could Never Feel Fear? One Woman Can't

scenes.text: What if you could never feel fear? One woman can't, and a snake didn't change that.
Her amygdala was destroyed by a rare disease, and she shows no fear of snakes, haunted houses or horror films.
She has spent most of her adult life without fear, and she laughed at the horror movies.
Then scientists made her breathe air with 35 percent carbon dioxide, when normal air has under one percent.
Within about 14 seconds she gasped, waved her hand and cried out for help.
Fear wasn't gone. It just had a second switch, the body's alarm for suffocation, and that switch still worked.

description:
What if you could never feel fear?
A woman known as SM has a damaged amygdala and shows no fear of snakes or haunted houses, yet a breath of carbon dioxide made her panic.
